summary.text: Fernando J. Martinez is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 29th District, which covers part of Loudoun County, and has served since January 10, 2024.
Martinez sits on the House committees on Counties, Cities and Towns; Communications, Technology and Innovation; and Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources.

paragraphs.text: Fernando J. Martinez was born in Victorville, California, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Martinez's education as Mt. Hood Community College (Associates of Science in Economics, 1983) and Portland State University (B.S. Computer Science and B.S. Economics, 1986).
The profile gives Martinez's occupation as retired.
The profile lists Martinez's military service as United States Air Force (December 31, 1970 to March 20, 1978).

Martinez's listed memberships and affiliations include Aurora School of Autism (vice chair); Loudoun Literacy Council (board member); Little League Baseball coach; Babe Ruth Baseball coach; Loudoun Women Abuse Shelter (volunteer); La Voz Hispanic Advocacy Group (board member).
